metadata.question: Did the regions around Mount Isa and Townsville in Queensland experience over 65 centimeters of rainfall between January 27 to February 10, 2019?

data.raw_code: The question is about rainfall in two regions in Queensland, Australia between January 27 to February 10, 2019. I need to: 1. Use precipitation data - likely from CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) which is good for rainfall analysis 2. Define geometries for Mount Isa and Townsville regions 3. Check if total rainfall exceeds 65cm (650mm) during that period 4. Handle data availability and quality issues Strategy: - Use CHIRPS daily precipitation data - Sum rainfall over the date range for each region - Check if sum > 650mm - Handle cases where data might be missing Data considerations: - CHIRPS has global coverage and good temporal resolution - Need to check if collection has data for this period and location - Need to validate pixel counts to ensure we have valid data ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const mountIsa = ee.Geometry.Point([139.4926, -20.7256]).buffer(50000); // 50km buffer around Mount Isa const townsville = ee.Geometry.Point([146.8169, -19.2590]).buffer(50000); // 50km buffer around Townsville const startDate = '2019-01-27'; const endDate = '2019-02-10'; // 2. Data Acquisition - CHIRPS daily precipitation const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('precipitation'); const collectionSize = chirps.size().getInfo(); console.log(`CHIRPS images in period: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("No precipitation data found for the period."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Sum rainfall over the period const totalRainfall = chirps.sum(); // Check valid pixels for both regions const mountIsaCount = totalRainfall.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: mountIsa, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); const townsvilleCount = totalRainfall.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: townsville, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`Mount Isa valid pixels: ${mountIsaCount}`); console.log(`Townsville valid pixels: ${townsvilleCount}`); if (mountIsaCount === 0 || townsvilleCount === 0) { console.log("No valid precipitation pixels in one or both regions."); console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation - Get mean rainfall for each region const mountIsaRainfall = totalRainfall.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: mountIsa, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); const townsvilleRainfall = totalRainfall.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: townsville, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`Mount Isa total rainfall (mm): ${mountIsaRainfall ? mountIsaRainfall.toFixed(1) : 'null'}`); console.log(`Townsville total rainfall (mm): ${townsvilleRainfall ? townsvilleRainfall.toFixed(1) : 'null'}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (mountIsaRainfall === null || townsvilleRainfall === null || isNaN(mountIsaRainfall) || isNaN(townsvilleRainfall)) { console.log("Invalid rainfall calculation result."); console.log("C3"); return; } // Check if either region exceeded 650mm (65cm) const mountIsaExceeded = mountIsaRainfall > 650; const townsvilleExceeded = townsvilleRainfall > 650; console.log(`Mount Isa >650mm: ${mountIsaExceeded}`); console.log(`Townsville >650mm: ${townsvilleExceeded}`); if (mountIsaExceeded || townsvilleExceeded) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
